cases.reply: Yes — cancelling three days ahead gives you more than 48 hours of notice, which qualifies for a full refund of the amount you paid.

Once a refund is approved, it goes back to your original payment method, and card refunds usually show up within 5 to 10 business days depending on your bank. If you paid with Apple Pay or Google Pay, it follows the timeline of the linked card. We can't send a refund to a different card or to a bank account.

Yes — changes made less than 24 hours before the appointment carry a $25 late change fee, since the professional has already planned their route. If you move it at least 24 hours ahead, rescheduling is free. Keep in mind you can reschedule a booking up to two times.

A deep cleaning is $240 for homes up to 1,500 square feet, so a small apartment would fall at that base price. It covers everything in a standard clean plus inside cabinets, baseboards, the oven, fridge interior, and window sills. Supplies and equipment are included.

Yes, we serve Denver, Colorado, covering addresses up to 25 miles from downtown. Just enter your ZIP code in the app to confirm your address is in our coverage area before booking.

Yes — plumbers (and electricians) must hold a valid state license, and we verify it before they're activated. Every professional also passes identity verification and a criminal background check before their first job, repeated annually, plus a skills assessment and safety training.

You can request account deletion in the app under Account Settings, then Privacy, and your account will be deleted within 30 days. You'll need to cancel any upcoming bookings first. Note that payment and invoice records are kept for seven years as tax law requires.

On Sundays, our human support agents are available from 9 AM to 5 PM Central Time. Just ask the assistant to connect you with a person during those hours, and an agent usually replies within 15 minutes. Outside those hours, your message is queued and answered first thing the next morning.

We don't handle pest control, I'm sorry — it's outside the services we offer, along with roofing, gas line work, and mold remediation. If you'd like, I can help you book one of the services we do cover.
